name: Dark Sense

description.content: When the trial starts, and after a Generator is completed, you earn [1] Token, up to [5].
When the Killer gets within [20m] of you, spend [1] Token. Then, for the next [15s]:

items: You see the Aura of Pallets and Windows within [32m].
You see the Auras of other Survivors.

quote: "Slow down, don't rush and try not to worry as much! The best way to beat him is to know how he thinks." -Lost Tapes: Murf
